mainEntity.name: What can I do to prepare my home for an interior remodeling project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Preparing your home for an interior remodel involves several steps to protect your belongings and facilitate efficient work. You should clear the project area of furniture, personal items, and decor. If possible, disconnect and store appliances. Consider setting up dust barriers in adjacent rooms to contain debris. This preparation ensures our team can begin work immediately and helps prevent damage to your valuables. Hometelligent Inc. can provide a checklist during the planning phase to guide you through this process for your San Leandro or Union City home.
